text: ふしぎな　おくりものを　ごりよう　いただき　ありがとう　ございます！

structure.jp: ふしぎな　おくりものを
ごりよう　いただき
structure.en: having received your use of it

structure.jp: ありがとう　ございます！

patterns.name: ご〜いただく
patterns.span: ごりよう　いただき
patterns.explanation: ご plus an action word plus いただく is a very polite way to say the other person kindly did it for us. Ending in いただき links it to the thanks that follow. ごりよう　いただき = 'for kindly using it'.
